events.title: Demo now Live!
events.summary: The demo for Echoes of Agony is now live! This demo contains all end-to-end features of the game, although the content is limited to around a third of the game's levels, items, upgrades, etc. I'm eager to hear your feedback/suggestions on the roguelike meta progression, tutorials, or anything else! You can join the Discord, or use the Steam Forums to convey your feedback

events.title: Alpha Demo now Live!
events.summary: Play the Alpha Demo here! I would love to hear your feedback/suggestions! You can use the form linked in game, join the Discord, or use the Steam Forums if you like This demo is focused on testing and validating the core combat in Echoes of Agony. events.title: New Mechanic : Overexertion
events.summary: Added a New mechanic: Overexertion. You can now go negative stamina , further delaying your next turn. The limit is that you can only go from 5 to -5 stamina, and once you're negative, you can't use more stamina to go further negative. It's a powerful tool to get an extra action, so going negative adds a Debuff that reduces your damage output and increases damage taken until your next turn - High Risk . High Reward PS : I realize the debuff name is clipping in the popup UI, its already been fixe

events.title: Visual Overhaul: New Lighting & Impact Effects.
events.summary: Working on the 'game feel' based on recent feedback. Today's update brings...Added some basic hit feedback - a white flashing shader, and small movement relative to the direction of the attacker.Notably, it only happens for attacks that actually damage health - so you won't see it if it hits a character's Guard meter, if the attack misses, or if its a Damage over Time effect.I'm looking into particle effects next to make the big hits really pop.
